Tests that when a request is made on a Geolocation object and its Frame is disconnected before a callback is made, no callbacks are made.

On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".

PASS No callbacks invoked
PASS successfullyParsed is true

TEST COMPLETE
